title: Goolge Image Model not supported v5
body:
### Description

trying to use  `google.imageModel(imagen-3.0-generate-001) or imagen 4`,   got error saying model not supported in v5


### AI SDK Version

v5

linked_prs.title: feat(provider/google-vertex): add imagen 4 model support
linked_prs.body:
## background

Users reported `imagen-3.0-generate-001` model not supported errors when using the Google provider. Investigation revealed this model is only available through Vertex AI, not the standard Google Generative AI API. Additionally, Google released new Imagen 4 models that provide improved image quality and generation capabilities.

## summary

- add imagen 4 model support to google-vertex provider
- add tests for imagen 4 variants

## verification

- all tests pass including new imagen 4 model tests
- model creation works for all three imagen 4 variants
- provider options and metadata handling verified

## tasks

- [x] model ids added to google-vertex-image-settings.ts
- [x] test for imagen-4.0-generate-preview-06-06
- [x] test for imagen-4.0-fast-generate-preview-06-06  
- [x] test for imagen-4.0-ultra-generate-preview-06-06
- [x] docs updated with new model capabilities table

## future work

* monitor imagen 4 models for GA release and remove preview suffixes

related issue #7411

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
The issue concerns unsupported LLM models ("google.imageModel(imagen-3.0-generate-001)" and "imagen 4") within the agent system, which falls under the "Unsupported models" sub-category of agent issues related to LLM provider compatibility.
